question_or_proposition: For Flow at Outfall 001, do the discharge limitation entries 'Report MGD' (lbs/day 30-Day Avg and Daily Max columns) and '***' (mg/l 30-Day Avg and Daily Max columns) establish that no enforceable numeric discharge limit applies to flow, such that reported flow measurements are subject only to reporting/monitoring requirements and not to numeric exceedance comparison?
required_context: Outfalls 001 limits table column headers distinguishing lbs/day vs mg/l and 30-Day Avg vs Daily Max
Adjacent pollutant rows in the same table that use Report, N/A, and *** in limitation columns
Flow row monitoring requirements (1/Day frequency, Estimate sample type)
source_locator: gcc/final_permit.pdf, Page 3, Section part_i, Outfalls 001 limits table, Flow row
notes: Interpretation of Report MGD and *** in the Flow limitation cells could change whether Purpose A treats flow as having an enforceable numeric limit or as report-only monitoring, and whether Purpose C classifies missing or non-comparing flow evidence as a no-data/compliance distinction versus required monitoring without adequate evidence.
